sections.title: Execution and work continuation

sections.title: Verification and testing
sections.decision: Require observable evidence in small chunks; capture test-discovered product bugs and ask before expanding scope.

sections.title: Code-quality and refactoring boundaries
sections.decision: Preserve behavior unless a goal explicitly authorizes a behavior change.

sections.title: Security, privacy, secrets, and compliance
sections.decision: Repository policy may tighten but never weaken ZzzOps safety and authority boundaries.
sections.rationale: record applicable project constraints without making safety optional

sections.title: Documentation and style
sections.decision: Follow evidenced repository documentation and style conventions.
sections.rationale: avoid imposing framework formatting on the target project

sections.title: Deployment, environment, and resources
sections.decision: Do not deploy without authority; execute sequentially unless bounded waiting work is safe to delegate.
sections.rationale: limits external impact and local resource contention

sections.title: Autonomy, approvals, and parallelism
sections.decision: Maximize safe autonomous progress; interview on consequential blockers; project and user ceilings both limit parallel work.
sections.rationale: balances autonomy with authority and resource control
